edges.fact: ASSISTANT recommends a Cooking or Baking Challenge as an activity for a family game night, as it involves choosing a theme or ingredient and having each family member create their own dish or dessert, followed by a taste-testing competition.
ASSISTANT recommends a Karaoke Contest as an activity for a family game night, as it allows everyone to take turns singing their favorite songs and can include fun prizes for the best performance.
ASSISTANT recommends a Movie Night as an activity for a family game night, as it involves choosing a family-friendly movie and setting up a cozy movie area with blankets, pillows, and snacks.

ASSISTANT recommends a Scavenger Hunt as an activity for a family game night, as it involves creating a list of items or challenges for family members to complete around the house or backyard, with the first one to finish winning.
ASSISTANT recommends the board game Ticket to Ride for a family game night, as it is easy to learn, fun to play, and suitable for ages 8+.
ASSISTANT recommends the game Cranium for a family game night, as it is a fun game that combines drawing, acting, trivia, and wordplay, and is ideal for families with kids aged 10+.
ASSISTANT recommends the game Pictionary for a family game night, as it is a classic drawing game that is perfect for families and suitable for ages 8+.

ASSISTANT recommends the game Scattergories for a family game night, as it is a creative game where players come up with words that fit certain categories, all starting with the same letter, and is suitable for ages 10+.
ASSISTANT recommends the game Would You Rather for a family game night, as it involves preparing a list of questions that spark interesting conversations and laughter.
